checkpoints.act: Tested the committed claim that the other 45 inverted rectangles carry no painting operator.

checkpoints.result: 27 of 46 paint, not 1. The scan reads raw stored bytes and never applies /Filter, so every FlateDecode appearance tests as silent. The 27 that paint are exactly the 27 that are compressed. Recorded as a correction; the shared record was not edited.

checkpoints.act: Established the cause of the 84 unaccounted stroke-only appearances before removing any of it.
checkpoints.method: Compared every stroke-only flattened XObject against every /AP /N substate of every widget on its own page of the pinned source, by normalised stream text, testing both identity and identity-minus-the-leading-opaque-background-fill.
checkpoints.result: 84 of 84 are a source /AP minus its background fill. Nothing invented, nothing removed. The court's own rule is `0 G 0 0.5 m 146.052 0.5 l s`.

checkpoints.act: Found the defect the stripped fill leaves, and proved it by eye.

checkpoints.result: 31 selection widgets (16 of 16 on the insert form, 15 of 17 on the bundle) sit over a check box the page itself prints. The delivered filing showed two concentric frames at every one. A 600 dpi crop shows one box on the official form and two on the delivered page.
